{{Top|leg}}
'''Pliers''' were a tool commonly found in [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kits]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> [[Ak-Buz]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], used a pair of long-nosed nonconductive machinist's pliers to steal a [[beignet]] that the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] had prepared from their master. The pliers were used to get past an small [[electric fence]] that was protecting the beignet.<ref name="Taster">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
